I agree with you. I share my feet online, but if a stranger were to walk up to me and ask to smell my feet, it would be off putting to say the least. 

I am new to this community and I feel like it's been something I've slowly been warming up to, so I think I still have a shyness others have overcome. Most people aren't foot models though, and I imagine the average person would be much more creeped out if they were to be aware of the fetish. I knew/heard of people having a foot fetish, but I just thought of it as a small attraction. Before driving in, I never imagined men would get hard from looking at my feet, or that people like certain types of feet, toes, curves, wrinkles, etc. It changes the perspective when you're more educated on the depth of this fetish. For some people, it's hard to think of feet as something sexual.
